svg.title: Silicon doping: an intrinsic silicon lattice, a p-type lattice where a boron atom leaves one bond short of an electron (a hole), and an n-type lattice where an antimony atom brings a fifth electron that is free to move
svg.desc: Three panels with the same flat 4 by 4 silicon lattice, every bond drawn as a shared pair of electrons. Middle: one silicon replaced by boron, with one bond missing an electron, marked as a hole. Right: one silicon replaced by antimony, with a fifth electron outside the bonds, marked as free. Schematic: the real lattice is three-dimensional (diamond cubic), and the drawing flattens it.
